reason: It's a brand-new company with no customers, and I don't put my bookings and driver records into anything until another operator at the association tells me it works. A$399 a month is fine if it's proven, but I'm not paying to be somebody's test case.
objection: Nobody I know runs it, and I can't tell if it really handles charter quoting and our accreditation and maintenance records properly or if it's generic fleet software with a bus label on it. If it falls over mid-season I've lost my bookings.
would_change_my_mind: A nearby operator or someone at the bus association vouching that they've run it for a few months, with charter quoting and accreditation records working, and it talking to Xero so my office manager isn't double-handling invoices.
